_about: The settings the daily pipeline reads. Changed only by the weekly review (or by Ajey), each change noted in LEARNINGS.md with the ledger rows behind it.
_slots: UTC hours: 08 = Australian evening, 19 = UK evening and US lunch, 01 (next day) = US evening. per_day of them each day, rotated with the formats so every format meets every slot (12 Nov 2026, Ajey: 2 a day to start).

A-herd-line.note: Default question: the herd's biggest miss. The camera pull only happens when the answer is well outside the middle 70% of guesses.

B-board.note: Weak when the #1 answer is under ~12% (a flat board: day 162 "whisk" 7%). Boards are sometimes reused from older Daily Herd days, so never say "yesterday" about the count.

C-dial.note: Default take: a near tie (gap <= 8 points) if there is one, else the most lopsided.

D-doodle.note: The doodle draws itself line by line; viewers race to guess. Credit Quick, Draw! (CC BY 4.0) in every post.

A-herd-line: Most people said {median}. The answer is {answer}.
C-dial: {players} people voted. Where do you land?
D-doodle: Can you guess it from one line?
Only {first_line} of {players} got it from one line
E-word-climb: Most people opened with {opener}. Bad idea?
F-secret-word: The herd needed {median} guesses. Can you beat that?
G-words-from: How many words can you make from {word}?
{hidden} words hide in {word}. How many can you find?
